about: PERF-02 — the per-route static JavaScript budget. Read by scripts/route-budget.mjs against the real production build; run by CI's Build job right after `pnpm run build`. A route's cost is its own module plus every parent layout plus everything they statically IMPORT — dynamic imports are excluded on purpose, because lazily loading something heavy is the fix rather than the defect.
why: MEASURED on main @ 482ddd6: three one-line barrel imports were costing /today 111.6 KB gzip of Recharts (for a 2.3 KB inline SVG), five routes ~44 KB raw of Settings/offline panels, and EVERY route 78.4 KB of generated colour data in the root chunk. None of it was visible in review, in a type, or in a lint. It is visible here.
howToRaise: `node scripts/route-budget.mjs --generate` re-derives every gzipBudgetBytes from the current build at 8% headroom, and does NOT touch the `forbid` lists. Re-generate when a route legitimately grew. Do not re-generate to answer a `forbid` failure: the ceiling is not what failed, and clearing it hides the thing that did.

fingerprints.about: A runtime is identified by a string its OWN source emits, not by a chunk filename — chunk names come from whichever module rolldown named the chunk after and move without anyone touching a dependency.

root.note: The one chunk set every route in the product pays for. Nothing route-specific belongs in it.

today.index.note: The default landing destination, so this is the first paint of the product for most sessions. Its Sparkline is an inline SVG in ~/shared/progress and must stay one: it must never reach the charting runtime again.

tasks.index.note: The Task record drawer embeds the Markdown editor, which is lazily loaded — so the editor VIEW runtime must not be static here. @codemirror/state was, through a value import in editor-commands.ts, until that import became type-only.

notes.index.note: Notes is the writing module, and even here the editor is opened rather than loaded with the collection.

routes/offline.note: The offline shell: precached by the service worker and rendered with no network at all, so its weight is paid at install time on a phone.
